text: In modal type theory (MTT, Gratzer et al.), modalities are handled by a context extension. A context Γ,⟨μ⟩ means:
choices: The context Γ restricted to the μ-mode
Γ with an additional modal variable
Γ with μ applied to the last type
explanation: In MTT, ⟨μ⟩ in context records the modal annotation; variables under ⟨μ⟩ can only be used in μ-modal positions.
